finding: UnifiedDB V10 now binds current-work credit to CURRENT work_id/spec_rev plus repo head, execution start and non-empty component hashes; stale/unknown work executions remain diagnostic evidence and cannot receive current-work credit. Revised local candidate passed 11/11 checks, preserves stale diagnostics and current bound receipts across restart, but remains TESTING and unpromoted.

negative_evidence.guard_overhead: 5000-pair local rate decreased from 29292.5 to 21893.7 pairs/s; p50 increased 0.024416 to 0.033665 ms and p95 0.043054 to 0.068912 ms in the same general sandbox lane; not a matched causal benchmark.

counterhypotheses: V9/manual or simpler routing may dominate V10 on real repo cost/correctness.
Work-revision binding may add coordination/storage overhead without enough stale-credit reduction in production.
boundaries: V10 is not promoted UnifiedDB state; V9 remains rollback baseline.
Semantic promotion eligibility and current-work credit are distinct.
Shared ancestry among implementation/test/receipt/mesh commits is not independent replication.
next_gate: Exact current-spec self-hosted Ubuntu/current-repo replay with work-revision churn, crash/restart and matched V9/manual cost-correctness comparison.
